steps.en: Install the skill into your agent's skills directory
steps.zh: 把 skill 装进 agent 的 skills 目录

steps.en: Hand the agent your data and the publishing occasion
steps.zh: 把数据和发布场合一起交给 agent
steps.code: Turn this CSV into a Glance chart suitable for a presentation.

steps.en: Judges the data shape and locks one chart type before drawing
steps.zh: 先判数据形状，锁定一个图型编号再动笔

steps.en: Reuses that template's real rendering code from the gallery HTML
steps.zh: 从 gallery 页复用该模板的真实渲染代码

steps.en: Optionally steer the palette in plain words, or let it auto-pick
steps.zh: 可以一句话指定配色，或让它自动选
steps.code: Rebuild this chart with the Porcelain preset.

steps.en: Locks one color system across the whole deliverable
steps.zh: 整份交付锁定一套色彩系统

steps.en: Assembles a double-clickable single-file HTML chart page or full report
steps.zh: 组装成双击即开的单文件 HTML 图表页或整页报告

value.en: Publish-ready HTML charts and bilingual reports in one consistent editorial language — no chart code, no style guide to write
value.zh: 同一套编辑视觉语言的可发布 HTML 图表与中英双语报告——不写图表代码，也不用自己定风格
